text:
zach: Hey team — planning to roll out reranker_v2 behind a flag. proposing incremental audience: 0.5% -> 2% -> 5% -> 20% over 3 days. goals: no >2% regression on CTR, p95 latency < 120ms, error rate <0.2%.
priya: Sounds good. can we add a hold if latency p95 increases by >10% vs baseline? also prefer separate gating for EU vs NA.
maria: +1 on regional gating. For the small slices let's keep user-level dedupe (one test per user) and exclude internal traffic.
zach: yep — exclude internal via `user_tags != "internal"`. gating rules I had in mind:
```
- step1: sample=0.5% (random by user_id), duration=2h, checks: p95_latency delta <=10%, ctr_delta >= -2%, errors <=0.2%
- step2: sample=2%, duration=4h, same checks
- step3: sample=5%, duration=8h, same checks
- step4: sample=20%, duration=24h, then promote
```
sam: Quick ask — what metric is primary? CTR or automated rerank satisfaction score? we need one primary stop-rule.
zach: primary = CTR (session-level top-1 click rate) because it's closest to product impact. secondary = rerank-quality est (eval harness).
priya: Add an automatic rollback if CTR drops by >2% with p<0.05 for the window; ops-bot can pause rollout. Also add alert for `tail_latency_increase` and `increased_401s/5xxs`.
harry: For experiment infra: please ensure the experiment has unique id `exp/rerank_v2_2026_q1` and that metric joins are stable for session attribution. We saw mismatch last time.
maria: Also schedule a canary smoke run only on cold-start flows (seq_len>512) to surface cache/kv regressions.
zach: good call. I'll add a smoke job that runs sample traffic through dedicated canary pool: `gpu-pool-canary-1`.
priya: For visibility — can we post per-step dashboards to #eng-platform-rollouts and create a tiny table of the checks? reduces back-and-forth.
sam: +1. I can add a small dashboard tile: CTR delta, p95 latency, error rate, and sample size.
deploy-bot: scheduled rollout `exp/rerank_v2_2026_q1` -> stage: step1 (0.5%) at 2026-03-18T14:00:00Z on cluster `canary`.
priya: who will be on on-call for the first 8 hours? I can cover EU morning. need NA overlap.
harry: I'll take NA first 6h. zach you on standby for the initial rollback bait? :eyes: 
zach: I'll be available and monitoring. will open a short postmortem template in case we abort.
ops-bot: Added guardrail policy: `if p95_latency > baseline*1.10 OR ctr_drop > 2% (stat sig)` then `pause` and notify `@eng-platform #oncall`.
priya: docs: I'll add a quick checklist to the experiment ticket: audience filters, dedupe, baseline windows, metric definitions, dashboards, and alert links.
sam: small note re audience overlap: make sure concurrent experiments are excluded or we bias check for overlapping cohorts >0.1%. we should block if overlap >1%.
maria: thanks. also remember to lock model version mapping in the spec so rollback is deterministic.
zach: ok final action items: (1) priya add checklist + alerts, (2) sam build dashboard tile, (3) harry set experiment id and confirm attribution join, (4) maria define smoke suite, (5) deploy-bot schedule step1 at the time above. will proceed once all done. :thumbsup:
priya: noted, will update ticket and ping here when alerts are wired.
harry: done with the experiment id and noisy-traffic exclusion rule. ping me when step1 goes live for immediate checks.
zach: thanks all — keeping channel updated.
ops-bot: Rollout policy saved to `rollouts/exp-rerank_v2_2026_q1.yml` (versioned).
deploy-bot: step1 started: 0.5% sample active. monitoring hooks engaged.
priya: seeing initial metrics — p50/p95 lat stable, CTR noisy but within expected CI. will let it run 2h then report.
sam: dashboard tile live: https://dashboards.internal/rerank_v2/exp-rerank_v2_2026_q1
priya: after 2h: no guardrail triggers. moving to step2 (2%).
deploy-bot: step2 scheduled and started.
priya: after step2 (4h): p95 latency +3%, CTR -0.4% (not sig). proceeding to step3 (5%).
zach: launching step3 now. everyone pls watch for regressed sessions.
priya: step3 running. will report after 8h.
harry: reminder: if any anomalous spike in `tail_kv_misses` report immediately.
sam: all set. good luck! :rocket:
